description_en: Creates an association between an Express Connect Router (ECR) and a route map
description_zh: 创建专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）与路由策略的关联关系
name: CreateRouteMapAssociation

parameters.help_en: The Express Connect Router (ECR) instance ID
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether it is a dry run only. Valid values:

true: sends a dry run request without modifying EPS resources.

false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the value from your client and ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The client token supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route map in the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
parameters.help_zh: 路由策略ID，即云企业网CEN（Cloud Enterprise Network）中的路由策略
parameters.name: route_map_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of region IDs of the Express Connect Router (ECR) where the routing policy is distributed and takes effect.

If this parameter is left empty, the routing policy is not distributed to any region
parameters.help_zh:
路由策略下发并生效的专线网关地域ID列表。

该参数为空时，路由策略不会下发到任何地域
parameters.name: region_id_list

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

AssociationId.description_en: The ID of the route map association

Code.description_en: The status code that indicates whether the call was successful. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure. For more information about the causes of failure, see error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示成功，返回其他值表示失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace `%s` in the ErrMessage response parameter.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, it indicates that the DtsJobId request parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Message.description_en: The message returned for the operation

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

True: The call was successful.

False: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

True：成功。
False：失败
